summary: Learn to structure blended finance vehicles, manage donor reporting, and build climate project pipelines. Enrol in this practical training course.
lede: Climate and development finance facility training covers how to structure capital, govern operations and track results. It is for professionals who manage, assess or report on facilities and need to turn funding commitments into prioritized project pipelines and controlled disbursements. Participants practice concessionality analysis, risk allocation, fiduciary workflows, and climate and development indicator reporting, supported by financial modelling and dashboard design.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who structure, finance, govern, monitor, or report climate and development finance facilities across public institutions, DFIs, commercial banks, donor-funded programmes, and sustainability functions.
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to public finance, banking, development programmes, investment appraisal, donor-funded operations, ESG reporting, or climate project preparation. Familiarity with budgets, financial statements, project pipelines, or grant and loan administration will help, but you do not need prior experience designing a blended finance vehicle. No programming is required. Exercises use Excel-style financial modelling and a Power BI dashboard specification rather than production software configuration. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted risk screening, Green Climate Fund investment logic, and Paris alignment receive conceptual awareness and operational application treatment, while capital-stack design, pipeline scoring, governance mapping, and reporting workflows receive hands-on practice.
